body.voice_description: Create an original voice for a gentle puppy chess companion. An adult female voice, soft, high and airy without whispering, with an innocent, wide-eyed sincerity and warm curiosity. Small, light resonance and gentle delighted reactions, then a calm and simple explanation. Sweet but natural speech, never baby talk, squeaky or theatrical. Fluent English at a normal conversational pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional adult voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.
body.text: Oh, there it is! That move leaves a piece with no defender. Let's check the reply together, then try to keep that piece protected.
